name: ainex-archive-frontend
description: AINEX Archive web frontend (React + Vite) with the shared @ainex/contracts package — served at https://timeless.uz

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ainex/contracts && npm run build -w @ainex/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @ainex/contracts && npm run dev -w @ainex/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @ainex/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @ainex/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @ainex/contracts && npm run test -w @ainex/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
